statements.t: “Separately, we have activated several sites in our Phase 3 ReVeRA-301 trial in AFib-RVR and look forward to enrolling the first patient.

The Company intends to follow the supplemental New Drug Application (sNDA) regulatory approval pathway and expects to leverage the initial PSVT indication and its safety database along with the results from the planned Phase 3 study in AFib-RVR.
The Company currently expects its cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments to be sufficient to cover operating expenses and capital expenditure into the second half of 2027.
